consequence.statement: The wireguard.userspaceFallback setting is deprecated and will be removed in a future release; users relying on WireGuard userspace-mode fallback must migrate to using Linux kernel WireGuard support.
consequence.remediation: Ensure your Linux kernel has native WireGuard support enabled and remove or disable the wireguard.userspaceFallback helm value in your Cilium configuration.

original.statement: The Helm value wireguard.userspaceFallback is deprecated and will be removed in a future version of Cilium; users must have Linux kernel WireGuard support.

decision.reason: [ev-2c2bce4c1f26] says the WireGuard userspace-mode fallback "has been deprecated and will be removed in a future version". So in 1.16.0 it still works and is only scheduled to go away later, which makes it a deprecation that needs review, not mandatory work. The statement that users must eventually move to kernel WireGuard support matches the evidence's "required to use a Linux kernel with WireGuard support going forward". The validators refuted the Helm key, but they checked the subject and change, not the consequence, so that refutation does not affect this consequence decision.
